favourites.title: Favourites
favourites.subtitle: Sitters you've saved, ready to book whenever you need them.
favourites.emptyText: Tap the heart on any sitter to save them here.

suspended.titleOk: Your account is in good standing
suspended.textSuspended: We've paused access to your WagStays account while our Trust & Safety team takes a closer look. You can't make or manage bookings in the meantime. If you think this is a mistake, our support team is happy to help.
suspended.textOk: There's nothing to worry about — your account isn't suspended.

accountClosed.title: Your account is closed
accountClosed.text: We've removed your login, photos and contact details and anonymised the rest. Past bookings and payments are kept without your name as a financial record. Thanks for being part of WagStays — give your pets a scratch from us.

pwa.iosTitle: Get booking updates on your iPhone
pwa.iosText: Tap Share, then Add to Home Screen. Open WagStays from your Home Screen to turn on notifications.
pwa.pushText: Get a notification when a sitter replies or your booking changes. You can turn it off anytime in Account Settings.

comingSoon.title: Loving, trusted pet sitters —
comingSoon.text: WagStays connects Toronto pet parents with verified local sitters and dog walkers. We're putting the finishing touches on the site — leave your email and we'll tell you the day we open.

features.meet: Free Meet & Greet before you book

comingSoon.notifyText: One email when we launch. No spam, ever.
comingSoon.becomeSitter: Want to sit pets with us? Sitter applications open at launch.
